layout: exactly seven files, one per original simulated creation day, with iMessage and email together
order: original written timestamp in the benchmark timezone, with frozen source identity breaking ties
release_order: unchanged frozen nightly cutoffs; reject input if its creation day differs from its original release day
body: preserve authored bytes, including literal quotations that survive the verified source projection; omit standalone prior-day records, backfill, context, summaries, generated annotations, and the one replayed email history suffix excluded by MemCal
metadata: deterministic inline envelope of source identity, sender, time, and channel-specific fields supplied by the matching MemCal fixture; provider storage metadata is separate
